title: Grant admin access to Principal ID txzwk-b2k4v-63dny-xpzzb-qz4ij-fivmw-kuzqk-o6ngk-kib7t-63zon-lae

requirements.text: In the backend Motoko actor (`backend/main.mo`), add the Principal ID `txzwk-b2k4v-63dny-xpzzb-qz4ij-fivmw-kuzqk-o6ngk-kib7t-63zon-lae` to the authorized admin list so that this user is granted admin access upon login.

quotes: can you give me admin access via principal id?

acceptanceCriteria: The Principal ID `txzwk-b2k4v-63dny-xpzzb-qz4ij-fivmw-kuzqk-o6ngk-kib7t-63zon-lae` is included in the hardcoded or initial admin set within the backend actor.
Calling `isAdmin()` from the backend while authenticated as this Principal returns `true`.
The Admin page in the frontend renders the full dashboard (submissions table, search, filter, CSV export) when logged in with this Principal ID.
No other existing admin principals are removed or affected.

constraints: Do not remove or modify any existing authorized admin principals.
Do not change any frontend authorization logic — the admin check must flow from the backend.
nonGoals: Adding a UI flow for dynamically managing admin principals.
Any changes to the Hindi translation or other page content.
Modifying the Principal ID display feature on the Admin page.
